parrafo_1.es: M & M Moving & Delivery es una empresa local de Fort Myers con 15 años de experiencia en mudanzas residenciales y comerciales. Mike y su equipo manejan desde un mueble suelto hasta la mudanza completa de una casa.
parrafo_1.en: M & M Moving & Delivery is a local Fort Myers company with 15 years of experience in residential and commercial moving. Mike and his crew handle everything from a single piece of furniture to a full household move.

parrafo_2.es: Licenciados, asegurados y acreditados por el Better Business Bureau. Nuestros clientes nos vuelven a llamar para su próxima mudanza.
parrafo_2.en: Licensed, insured and Better Business Bureau accredited. Our clients call us back for their next move.

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué te mudas y a dónde. Mike mismo suele responder, incluso un domingo.
texto.en: Tell us what you are moving and where. Mike himself often picks up, even on a Sunday.

texto.es: Te damos un precio razonable según el tamaño de la mudanza, sin sorpresas el día del trabajo.
texto.en: We give you a fair price based on the size of the move, no surprises on moving day.

texto.es: Llegamos puntuales, empacamos y protegemos cada mueble, y nos adaptamos si algo cambia de último momento.
texto.en: We arrive on time, pack and protect every piece of furniture, and adapt if something changes at the last minute.

texto.es: Descargamos y acomodamos todo en el nuevo lugar, sin prisa y sin daños.
texto.en: We unload and set everything up in the new place, no rushing and no damage.

nota.es: Cada mudanza se cotiza según el tamaño y la distancia. Llámanos y te damos el detalle sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every move is quoted based on size and distance. Call us and we will walk you through it, no strings attached.

texto.es: De un apartamento a una casa o al revés, dentro de Fort Myers y alrededores, con el mismo cuidado en cada mueble.
texto.en: From an apartment to a house or the other way around, around Fort Myers and nearby, with the same care for every piece of furniture.

texto.es: Si te vas de la ciudad, coordinamos el viaje completo para que tus cosas lleguen cuando y como corresponde.
texto.en: If you are leaving town, we coordinate the full trip so your things arrive when and how they should.

texto.es: ¿No tienes dónde guardar todo mientras te mudas? Te damos una opción de almacenamiento local.
texto.en: Nowhere to keep everything while you move? We offer a local storage option.

texto.es: Oficinas y negocios también se mudan: coordinamos el trabajo para que afecte lo menos posible tu operación.
texto.en: Offices and businesses move too: we coordinate the job to affect your operation as little as possible.

pie.es: ¿Es un trabajo puntual, como mover un mueble pesado? Llámanos igual, no hay trabajo demasiado chico.
pie.en: Is it a one-off job, like moving a heavy piece of furniture? Call us anyway, no job is too small.

items.quote: Absolutely amazing experience! Called Mike on a Sunday morning. Within 1 hour he had Earl dispatched on location to move a pool table across town. Not only did he delicately dismantle it, but expertly reassembled it as well. Incredibly friendly staff. Prompt, professional, and such a pleasure to do business with.

Thank you Michael and staff. Highly professional in every manner. They have moved home furnishings for me on 3 separate occasions in the last 12 months. Each move was carried out with precision. Movers arrived at the desired time on each occasion. Great care was taken with each piece of furniture.

One of the best companies I've worked with in all Fort Myers. On time, respectful, courteous, professional, hard working, caring, no wasting time. M&M Moving values its reputation and the experience reflects that. Great group of men.
